text: ἐσθίει ὁ Δεινόσαυρος τὸν ἄρτον· νῦν οὐ πεινᾷ.
objects: a small woven flax sack, tan with a drawstring, soft and slightly wrinkled, sized to fit in Dinosaur’s hands.
a merchant’s stall table of chalk-white wood with neat woven baskets and a blue-painted edge.
a round rustic loaf of bread with a golden-brown crust and a cross-slashed top, about the size of Dinosaur’s head.
a basket of red apples, glossy and firm, heaped in a shallow wicker tray.
a tall clay water jar, terracotta with a simple blue band near the shoulder.
artist_notes: Add a few breadcrumbs in the air and a big satisfied smile.
positioning: Dinosaur stands just to the side of the stall, three-quarter view, holding the loaf with both hands and taking a big bite, eyes happy.
Emporos remains behind the stall, front view, watching with a pleased smile.
The small woven sack rests at Dinosaur’s left side, undisturbed.
The merchant’s stall table remains in place with baskets tidy.
The round rustic loaf is in Dinosaur’s hands with a fresh bite missing at the edge.
The basket of red apples sits prominently near the front corner of the table.
The tall clay water jar stands near the back, catching a soft highlight.
